theme: An open day winding down — board prep and a booking deadline lead into tomorrow.
greeting: The day's one call is behind you, Dan, and the evening is clear. Tomorrow's NACD prep session and the December-trip book-by date are the two things worth getting ahead of before you close the laptop.

needsAttention.title: NACD New England prep session
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow at 1 PM on Zoom — the prep call for the chapter's Oct 28 event. Arrive having reviewed the Oct 28 agenda and your part in it so the hour moves.

needsAttention.title: December trip — book by Oct 15
needsAttention.detail: The decision was due Sept 30 and the book-by is eight days out. Holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year. Pick the domestic default or commit to refundable-international — don't shortlist across both.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: A p1 in your list, overdue since Sept 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week sells out early; book it refundable now and fix the dates later.

needsAttention.title: Drive the Pathfinder south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5-18 Portland-to-St Pete window is open now. Two drivers, two days, one hotel night — book that night once the dates are set.

flagged.title: Tokyo board-search contact replied
flagged.detail: Your autumn check-in to the Japan search contacts drew a reply — no openings right now, but you'll be kept in mind.

flagged.title: Aon MD role flagged
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert surfaced a Director, Strategic Engagement opening at Aon.

flagged.title: St Pete Beach signing request
flagged.detail: A SabalSign e-signature reminder for 102 26th Ave is waiting on your signature.

inbox.noise: Mostly retail and newsletter churn — OXO, Redbubble, The Company Store, Disney, a couple of Patreon posts.
inbox.clear: Nothing else in the inbox needs you tonight.

recipe.title: Roasted kabocha squash
recipe.why: Kabocha and the hard winter squashes are at their autumn peak now, dense and sweet in the cooling air.

tasks.title: Get three term-life quotes for Mike
Portland house order — bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder
Passport packet + rescheduled appointment for the four kids
Call dermatologist to book the removal appointment

acts.line: An open stretch with nothing on the calendar — the kind of quiet that's easy to spend well.
One 30-minute Teams call with Mike on Valoris accounting breaks the quiet at 2.
Clear, with tomorrow's NACD prep the one thing worth reading into before the day ends.
